name: Barrood Agency
what_they_do: Full-service independent insurance and bonding agency operating since 1940 (80+ years), writing personal lines (home, auto, boat, motorcycle), business coverage (commercial auto, general liability, builders risk, cyber, D&O, umbrella, workers' comp), bonds and life/health, with access to excess and surplus carriers. Also runs real estate and travel divisions.
customers: Families and individuals for personal lines, plus hundreds of small and mid-sized businesses, contractors and professionals needing commercial coverage and surety bonds across Somerset and Middlesex counties.

size_signals.signal: 'For over 80 years… serving our client's Insurance, Real Estate and Travel needs since 1940'; celebrating the 80-year milestone
Two offices (46 Bayard St Suite 212, New Brunswick and Somerset NJ), described as 'a division of Enterprise Risk Associates'; dedicated surety bond department and team page
Sister business Barrood Real Estate and a travel division - inference: a mid-sized family agency group, likely 10+ staff

listing.platform: Liberty Mutual independent-agent directory (Somerset office listing) - Google listing for the New Brunswick office not confirmed

website_review.primary_cta: 'START QUOTES' / 'Start A Quote' plus a click-to-call phone button in the header
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: Multi-step online quote request covering 16 coverage types (auto, home, condo, renters, BOP, work comp, builders risk, cyber etc.), plus client services login and referrals pages
website_review.trust_signals: 80 years in business, named client testimonials, offices and hours in the footer, reviews page, SMS consent and accessibility statements, carrier relationships and E&S access
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Nothing materially out of date found - recent theme (2025 image uploads), current pages, SMS consent page; the schema still carries an old address (see issues)
website_review.search_basics: Unique titles per page ('Start Your Quotes in Seconds | Barrood Agency'), meta description naming Somerset NJ, per-line business insurance pages, InsuranceAgency + Organization + WebSite JSON-LD; hero headline leads with 'SOMERSET, NJ' rather than New Brunswick
top_issues: The InsuranceAgency JSON-LD contains a wrong address: '6417 Roosevelt Ave', addressLocality 'Somerset and Middlesex County', addressRegion 'NY', postalCode '11204' - a Brooklyn, NY address - which contradicts the real New Brunswick and Somerset offices and would feed false answers to search and AI assistants.
Phone links are malformed (href="tel:(732)%20247-8664", with parentheses and a space) so tap-to-dial fails on many phones despite the visible phone button.

Structured data has no openingHours or areaServed, and the homepage positions the firm as 'Insurance Agency Somerset, NJ' while the New Brunswick office (the batch listing) has no dedicated location page - inference: the New Brunswick storefront is under-promoted.

agent_readiness.notes: Site is crawlable, well-titled, with service pages and a real multi-step quote request (no CAPTCHA, 31 labels, 16 coverage types). InsuranceAgency schema exists but its address is wrong (NY 11204) and there are no hours or areaServed; phone hrefs are malformed. An agent can submit a detailed quote request but cannot get an instant quote or book a time.

operations_signals.signal: Quote intake is a long multi-step form (45 inputs across steps) that a staff member must then work by hand with carriers - inference: each new-business quote consumes agent time and is where AI-assisted prefill would pay off.
Firm publishes a 'CLIENT SERVICES' portal and referrals and reviews pages, showing an organised service operation rather than ad-hoc paper.
Testimonials emphasise responsiveness ('always get back to you… with no delays') - response speed is the firm's stated differentiator.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Fix the knowledge layer: correct the InsuranceAgency schema address, add openingHours/areaServed for both offices, fix tel: hrefs, and add a New Brunswick location page - so search and AI assistants answer correctly.
top_opportunities.evidence: JSON-LD address reads 6417 Roosevelt Ave, region NY, postal 11204; phone hrefs contain parentheses/spaces; no hours in schema and no New Brunswick page.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Quote-intake assistant that pre-fills the multi-step form from a document (registration, dec page, business info), chases missing items and drafts the submission for the agent.
top_opportunities.evidence: Quote flow needs 45 field values across 16 coverage types and staff must then shop carriers by hand.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Renewal and service automation: automated renewal reviews, certificate-of-insurance requests and review requests on a schedule, so the service team is not re-keying routine work.
top_opportunities.evidence: Agency sells commercial lines and bonds where COI requests and renewals are constant; they already have a client services portal to integrate with.

scores.reasons: The site and quote flow are genuinely good, so the gap is concentrated in wrong schema, malformed phone links and a missing New Brunswick presence; an 80-year agency with commercial lines, a bond department and real estate has clear budget.
